NORD 332.title: Nordic Studies in Focus
NORD 332.description: Topics that respond to current events and emerging research in Nordic cultural studies. Find out which special topic will be explored in the current or coming year at A maximum of 6 credits will be granted for SCAN_V 332 or NORD_V 332.

NORD 333.title: Nordic Literary Cultures
NORD 333.description: Contemporary and historical Nordic literatures that reflect the major societal, political and cultural aspects of the circumpolar North.

NORD 334.title: Nordic Contemporary Fiction
NORD 334.description: Explore Nordic societies through recent literature translated from Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, Sámi languages, Icelandic, and other Nordic languages.

NORD 336.title: Nordic Crime Fiction, Film and Television
NORD 336.description: Explore Nordic crime stories as a mirror and critique of their societies.

NORD 337.title: Nordic Cinema
NORD 337.description: Examine the technical, narrative, and aesthetic features of Northern European films.

NORD 338.title: The Viking World
NORD 338.description: Wars, migrations and settlements of the Viking Age (800-1100) as seen through the Icelandic sagas, and the afterlife of the Viking world in modern culture.

NORD 339.title: Norse Mythology
NORD 339.description: The pagan mythology of pre-Christian Scandinavia and its later appropriations and recycling.

NORD 340.title: Sámi Histories and Cultures
NORD 340.description: Cultural history of the Sámi peoples, the Indigenous peoples of northern Norway, Sweden, Finland and Russias Kola Peninsula. Focus on traditional culture, colonization, and decolonization.

NORD 341.title: Indigenous Activism
NORD 341.description: Examination of contemporary political and social conflicts in the circumpolar north, focusing on ways Indigenous people have used art, performance and activism as a tool for resistance and decolonization.

NORD 399.title: Directed Studies
NORD 399.description: Investigation of readings and research undertaking topics of Nordic Studies, with the agreement and under the supervision of a faculty member with relevant expertise. Restricted to Nordic Studies students with approval from the Director of Undergraduate Studies.

NORD 411.title: Nordic Drama and Film
NORD 411.description: Examine the origins of Nordic drama and film and their influences on these art forms worldwide.

NORD 412.title: Epics of Northern Europe
NORD 412.description: Explore epics of Northern Europe, their connections to nationalism, and their re-imaginings in contemporary Nordic literature.

NORD 413.title: Baltic Cultures and Literatures
NORD 413.description: Examination through literature of the historical, cultural, and ethnic elements that have made the Baltic area (Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania) the crossroads of northeastern Europe.

NORD 414.title: Topics in Northern European Cultural Studies
NORD 414.description: Selected topics for advanced study, such as activism, ethnicity, gender, identity, migration, sexuality, and justice across Northern Europe.

NORD 415.title: The World of the Sagas
NORD 415.description: Explore the medieval and early modern world of the Nordic region through the Icelandic sagas and their literary, cultural, and historical context.

NORD 499.title: Directed Studies
NORD 499.description: Advanced research undertaking topics of Nordic Studies, with the agreement and under the supervision, of a faculty member with relevant expertise. Restricted to Nordic Studies students with approval from the Director of Undergraduate Studies.
